detail.name: [Affinity] Greater Heights
detail.desc:
Banyue has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Greed Burns Like Fire]</color>.
Greed Burns Like Fire: When Banyue hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, he inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state. In this state, enemies' <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
detail.desc2:
Beyond every peak lies an even higher summit. Whether in martial arts or character, Banyue always strives to reach greater heights.
Looking back now, his achievements stand tall and proud.
